subject: Hybrid oncall sculpt + uptime buffers — pricing and human-backstop ask
body:
From: Jade Park <jade@helios.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Soto <alex.soto@helios.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Hybrid oncall — human-backstop and micro-banding question

SoojIN,

Thanks for the demo last week — Helios is seriously interested in Redwood's Dedicated offering, but we need clarity on two things before legal and procurement will move forward:

1) Human-backstop: for our most critical endpoints we need a guaranteed human-oncall escalation (not just automated fallbacks). Can you confirm how that is priced and whether it sits as a retainer or per-incident credit?

2) Response micro-banding: our traffic pattern is spiky; we care about sub-hour response tiers (e.g., <15m, 15–60m, 1–4h) and want to understand how you translate those into credits at scale. Can Redwood map these micro-bands to a simple unit economics model?

Also attached is a short MOP (helios_mop_request.xlsx) with our critical endpoints and required RTOs.

Appreciate a quick sketch so we can align with procurement timelines (ideally by end of month).

— Jade
Director of Platform Reliability, Helios AI

-----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jade Park <jade@helios.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hybrid oncall — human-backstop and micro-banding question

Hi Jade —

Thanks for the clear MOP and the specific bands. High-level answers and an initial commercial sketch below; attaching a one-pager (proposal_hybrid_oncall_v1.pdf).

Human-backstop pricing (summary):
- Retainer + burn credits hybrid: baseline retainer reserves a named human oncall band (up to 12 hours/month coverage) at $12k/month.
- Excess incidents beyond the retainer are charged as "human backstop credits" at $750/incident for P1s (first 30m triage) and $450/incident for P2s (first 60m triage).
- We offer a limited pilot concession: first 3 P1 human backstop incidents billed at 50% as a trial allowance.

Response micro-banding (how we model it):
- We translate your traffic into a 4-tier micro-band SKU: 0–15m, 15–60m, 1–4h, >4h. For each critical endpoint you map an expected monthly consumption (incidents/month).
- Pricing sheet: per-incident credit cost decreases with aggregate commit (e.g., 0–10 incidents = 100% unit, 11–50 = 85% unit, 51+ = 70% unit).
- If you commit to a Dedicated capacity slab (GPU commit x months), we tier the human-credit unit by 15% off list.

Operational notes:
- The retainer gives you an assigned oncall rotation and 24/7 escalation path; credits let you exceed the retainer without renegotiating.
- All incidents trigger automated runbooks; human-backstop only invoked if automation cannot resolve within the micro-band SLA.

Next steps I propose:
1) We draft a short PO-friendly amendment that lists: endpoints covered, retainer term, pilot allowance.
2) Ben and Marissa will review the concession band internally and confirm ledger accounting (billing flow).
3) If that looks OK, we'll hand the paper to procurement & legal (we can seed DocuSign).

Can you confirm which 3 endpoints you want covered in the pilot retainer?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hybrid oncall — human-backstop and micro-banding question

Quick notes from pricing ops:
- The $12k retainer maps to a named engineer coverage SLA and is financially neutral if Helios converts to a 12-month commit at >= $75k/mo (we can convert retainer credit toward commit).
- Pilot concession (first 3 P1 at 50%) is OK from my side but let's cap total pilot exposure to $4k absolute.
- Recommend a 10% one-time onboarding fee to cover runbook integration and SOC logging hookup.

I'll prepare a short price memo we can attach to the doc prior to sending to procurement.

— Ben
Enterprise Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hybrid oncall — human-backstop and micro-banding question

Agree to the pilot concession but narrow the scope:
- Pilot = up to 3 P1 human backstops across the three named endpoints only; after pilot, incidents billed at full unit unless Helios signs a 12-month Dedicated commit.
- No open-ended discounts beyond the $4k pilot cap.
- Approve the 10% one-time onboarding fee (document as a professional services line item).

Soojin, Ben — get the PO-friendly amendment drafted with explicit countersign fields and the onboarding acceptance checkbox.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success & Pricing, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Alex Soto <alex.soto@helios.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jade Park <jade@helios.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 17:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hybrid oncall — human-backstop and micro-banding question

Soojin / Marissa / Ben —

This looks workable. We confirm the three pilot endpoints (auth-service, billing-ingest, realtime-infer) and accept the $12k retainer plus the onboarding fee. Please send the amendment and DocuSign link; procurement will need the HubSpot deal reference (attached link preferred).

Two small asks before we sign:
1) Can you add a 72-hour rollback clause for the retainer in the pilot (Helios may scale down endpoints during the 60-day pilot window)?
2) Can you provide a short paragraph explaining how credits surface on the monthly invoice (line itemized vs aggregated)?

If you can get those in the first pass amendment we'll route to legal the same day.

Thanks — Alex
Contracts Lead, Helios AI

[Attachments referenced: proposal_hybrid_oncall_v1.pdf (PDF, 312KB); helios_mop_request.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)]
